method: Contact sheets of the actual atlas crops, followed by full-resolution inspection of suspected issues and original generation outputs. This is not specialist or all-library certification.

issues.finding: Three source grids have nonuniform row spacing. Equal division admitted neighboring labels and cut off the current cell top.
issues.resolution: Use measured original-image separator coordinates; wearing illustrations retained.

issues.finding: The old illustration showed a stiff platform toe and duplicated the pointe-shoe reference FW087.
issues.resolution: New original soft ballet-slipper illustration with pliable toe, split flexible sole and ribbon attachment points; FW087 preserved.

issues.finding: The frontal depiction did not expose the under-arch stirrup band, so it was hard to distinguish from footless tights.
issues.resolution: New original three-quarter product depiction with matching sole inset; heel and forefoot remain exposed.
